content: === Introduction ===
Hepato-biliary diseases include liver diseases and biliary diseases. Their study is known as hepatology.
=== Liver diseases ===
<info> Acute hepatitis D – this is a superinfection with the delta-agent in a patient already infected with hepatitis B
<info> Other viral hepatitis viruses may exist but their relation to the disease is not firmly established like the previous ones (hepatitis F, GB virus C, hepatitis X)

<info> Hepatitis:
cytomegalovirus infection
herpesviral: herpes simplex infection
<info> Portal hypertension in schistosomiasis
<info> Liver disease in syphilis
<info> yellow fever virus infection
<info> herpesviral: herpes simplex infection
<info> primary biliary cholangitis (primary biliary cirrhosis)
<info> phlebitis of the portal vein

<info> granulomatous hepatitis
berylliosis
sarcoidosis
This may cause fatty liver, hepatitis, fibrosis and sclerosis leading to cirrhosis and finally liver failure.
This includes mostly drug-induced hepatotoxicity, (DILI) which may generate many different patterns over liver disease, including
<info> acute hepatitis and chronic hepatitis of different forms,
<info> Effects of Acetaminophen (Tylenol)
<info> other rare disorders like focal nodular hyperplasia, Hepatic fibrosis, peliosis hepatis and veno-occlusive disease.
Liver damage is part of Reye syndrome.
Malignant neoplasm of liver and intrahepatic bile ducts. The most frequent forms are metastatic malignant neoplasm of liver)

<info> liver cell carcinoma
hepatocellular carcinoma
hepatoma
<info> other sarcomas of liver
Benign neoplasm of liver include hepatic hemangiomas, hepatic adenomas, and focal nodular hyperplasia (FNH).
Chronic liver diseases like chronic hepatitis, chronic alcohol abuse or chronic toxic liver disease may cause
<info> liver failure and hepatorenal syndrome
<info> fibrosis and cirrhosis of liver
Cirrhosis may also occur in primary biliary cirrhosis. Rarely, cirrhosis is congenital.

<info> metabolic diseases (chapter E in ICD-10)
haemochromatosis
Wilson's disease
Gilbert's syndrome
Crigler–Najjar syndrome
Dubin–Johnson syndrome
Rotor syndrome
Bile acid synthesis disorders
<info> Bile acid synthesis disorders
<info> chronic passive congestion of liver
<info> central haemorrhagic necrosis of liver
<info> Congenital cystic disease of the liver
<info> Cysts caused by Echinococcus
Amyloid degeneration of liver
